payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate y from 0 upwards, subtracting x minutes from wake time modulo 1440 until time contains digit '7'. Simple linear exhaustive check.
payload.rationale: The loop tests consecutive snooze counts, which is a brute-force search. None of the specific subtypes (backtracking, bitmask, etc.) directly apply. Backtracking is the most generic among the candidates, but the fit is poor as there is no recursive trial-and-error.
